title: Missed-Earning Tier Rate Schedule by Twelve-Month Net Spend — Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
On a **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** missed-earning posting for an Autoship shipment, the missed-earning rate starts from a tier rate. A membership holding Pals Rewards Member or Pals Rewards Insider takes a higher tier's base earn rate where its net qualifying spend over the last 12 months has reached that tier's spend figure.

**Net qualifying spend over the last 12 months** is the qualifying spend of the membership's points-earning entries dated in the last 12 months, less the qualifying spend of its points-reversal entries dated in the last 12 months.

## Schedule

| Tier held | Net qualifying spend over the last 12 months | Tier rate (points per qualifying dollar) |
|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member or Pals Rewards Insider | $750.00 or more | 12 — the base earn rate of Pals Rewards VIP |
| Pals Rewards Member | $250.00 or more, but below $750.00 | 10 — the base earn rate of Pals Rewards Insider |
| any other membership | — | no other tier's rate is taken under this schedule |

"Any other membership" covers a Pals Rewards Insider below $750.00, a Pals Rewards Member below $250.00, a Pals Rewards VIP, and every Tailwise Plus tier.

## Both sides of each figure (hypothetical spend)

| Tier held | 12-month net spend | Tier rate under the schedule |
|---|---|---|
| Pals Rewards Member | $249.99 | none |
| Pals Rewards Member | $250.00 | 10 |
| Pals Rewards Member | $749.99 | 10 |
| Pals Rewards Member | $750.00 | 12 |
| Pals Rewards Insider | $749.99 | none |
| Pals Rewards Insider | $750.00 | 12 |
| Pals Rewards VIP | $2,000.00 | none |

**Netting (hypothetical).** Earnings of $820.00 and reversals of $95.00 in the last 12 months give net qualifying spend of $725.00: a Pals Rewards Member takes 10, a Pals Rewards Insider takes no other tier's rate.
